note: Track sus-add9 (guitar-extended-chords), step 1: Dsus2 and Dsus4 as one finger off or on a D, a bar of each, then changing inside the bar.

exercise.title: Dsus2 and Dsus4 around D
exercise.why: Dsus2 is D with one finger lifted and Dsus4 is D with one finger added, both on the high E string, so the rest of your hand stays still while one note moves.

cells.text: Press a chord box below to hear it, then fret each chord as shown. Change from D to Dsus2 and back, then from D to Dsus4 and back, until only the one finger moves.

Press Play below to start the metronome. After a bar of count-in, the lit box shows the chord to play: strum down on every beat.
Keep the fingers on the G and B strings pressed down through every change.

Press Play below to start the metronome and strum down on every beat. The chord now changes in the middle of the bar: two beats of D, then two beats of a sus chord.
If the finger comes late, keep your strumming hand going and catch the next change.
